title: adesmia campestris
intro: Adesmia campestris, commonly known as "Queñua chica", is a plant species native to South America, particularly in the Andean regions of Argentina, Chile, and Peru. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The plant is known to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, pain relief, and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Adesmia campestris include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
